reason: Our cook grinds fresh mint-coriander chutney in a steel dabba twice a week, so I already have authentic, delicious chutney in my fridge at zero incremental cost. Buying a packaged factory paste would be completely redundant.
objection: Fresh homemade green chutney is already readily prepared at home for free, making packaged chutney unnecessary.
would_change_my_mind: Unique fusion sauces or specialized restaurant-style dips that cannot easily be made at home by a cook.
